concept.hr: Smjer, tranzitivnost, povjerenje između šuma i vanjsko: tko smije kamo
concept.en: Direction, transitivity, forest vs external trusts: who can access what

summary.hr: Gradi povjerenja između šuma i testiraj pristup: pristup ide suprotno od strelice, vanjsko povjerenje nije tranzitivno, a povjerenje nije dozvola.
summary.en: Build trusts between forests and test access: access flows against the arrow, an external trust is not transitive, and a trust is not a permission.
